message:
As we navigate our busy lives, it’s easy to overlook the importance of being prepared for unexpected moments. Rediscovering low-tech fun can be a wonderful way to bond with our family while also planning for the unexpected. The resource we’re sharing helps us outline simple steps to create a family emergency plan that suits our needs.

Let’s embrace this opportunity to connect and reflect on how we can support each other in times of uncertainty. After all, being prepared doesn’t have to be a daunting task—it can be a chance to come together and strengthen our family ties. What’s one fun way you’ve found to prepare with your loved ones? 😊
